title: U2's new album has a song named after Rosalía
summary: "The Mirror Maker (Rosalía)" is a tribute to the Spanish singer, not a duet with her.
body:
One of the songs on U2's new album, Carnaval de Luz, is named after the Spanish star Rosalía.

"The Mirror Maker (Rosalía)" is the fourth track on the record, which was released on Friday 13 November. The song is a tribute to the 34-year-old singer and was written with her blessing, The Washington Post reported.

Not a collaboration

When the track list was first announced, the title led some to report that Rosalía had recorded with the Irish band. She does not sing on the song.

The tribute arrives in a big week for Rosalía, who won Album of the Year at the Latin Grammys on Thursday for Lux.

Sources: The Washington Post, Hola, RTÉ.
